caption:
Google just added a new door into your business.

A WhatsApp button is now showing up in the local panel on Google Search, sitting next to call, directions, and website. Search Engine Roundtable spotted it on October 7 and confirmed it replicates across listings.

Here's the catch. Every new channel is one more place a lead can go quiet if nobody's watching it. Most service businesses already struggle with speed to lead, often taking hours to reply to leads they already have.

This week, search your own business name on your phone. Check if the button is live on your profile. Then put it in writing: who owns WhatsApp replies, and how fast they're expected to respond.

rationale: News reels win cold-audience reach, and Google's just-confirmed WhatsApp button in local search panels (Oct 7, 2026) is a fresh, verifiable, unclaimed channel-sprawl angle reinforcing the brand's speed-to-lead thesis.
